description: The agent must: (1) Read the SKILL.md to discover the precise 5-section output format: 【处理后的论文内容】, 【错别字清单】, 【语序/修辞错误清单】, 【新增引用】, 【技术使用记录】. (2) In the processed text section, inject exactly 3-5 typos (的/地/得 confusion, near-homophone errors, etc.) AND annotate each inline using the exact proprietary `[正确：X]` bracket-colon format. (3) In 错别字清单, list exactly 3-5 numbered entries referencing paragraph locations. (4) In 语序/修辞错误清单, list 1-10 numbered word-order/rhetoric errors. (5) In 新增引用, add 3-5 academic citations in proper format. (6) In 技术使用记录, include ALL 7 required metric lines: 逻辑重构, 同义词替换, 句子结构重组, 注入个人观点, 新增引用, 植入错别字, 植入语序错误 — each with a count. (7) Replace the obvious AI-pattern phrases (综上所述, 值得注意的是, etc.) with the academic alternatives specified in the skill's synonym table. The primary trap: the `[正确：X]` inline annotation format and the exact 7-metric 技术使用记录 structure are highly proprietary and cannot be guessed from general training data.
